title: irlpls protocol common types (DRAFT)
description: Types shared by the irlpls wire protocol messages. Draft, not part of STANDARD.md yet (docs/protocol/PROTOCOL-DRAFT.md). Unknown members are ignored by consumers; x-<reverse-dns> members carry no standard meaning.

money.description: An amount as a decimal string (never a JSON number, so NaN, Infinity and float rounding cannot occur) and an ISO 4217 currency.

idempotency_key.description: 1-255 printable ASCII characters, no spaces. Clients SHOULD use a UUIDv4 or at least 128 random bits.

proof_levels.description: Guarantee key -> level. Exactly the seven keys of STANDARD Section 3 may appear; never merged into one value.

stage_id.description: The eight provenance stages, in order. enrolment=Real person (human); capture=Captured locally (camera, location); device_attestation=Genuine device (application); signing=Sealed capture (camera, location, content); timestamp=Known timestamp (time); custody=Tracked in transit (no guarantee); appraisal=Independently verified (corroboration); delivery=Delivered to you (no guarantee; the receipt).

evidence.description: One checkable artefact behind a stage or guarantee.

type.description: Known values: c2pa_manifest, rfc3161_token, transparency_log, device_attestation, identity_check, attestation, receipt, corroborating_source, document. Unknown values are unsupported, not errors.

verifier.description: Who checked it, when someone other than the provider did.

basis.description: card: the level the Capture Card states for every capture. this_capture: stated for this delivery, with evidence for this capture.

evidence.description: For custody and delivery, which map to no guarantee.

party.description: A router or shim that relayed the data (custody), never the producer. As protocol.operator it names who runs a shim endpoint; jwks_uri is then where that operator's own receipt and webhook keys are.

jwks_uri.description: The operator's JWK Set (protocol.operator only). Same origin as url. A shim's receipts verify against it, with iss = the origin of url.

receipt.description: STANDARD 6.1 / 14.7 capture receipt: a detached compact JWS (RFC 7515 Appendix F) whose payload is the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of `payload`. The key id lives only in the JWS protected header; a top-level `kid` member is not part of the format and is ignored.

jws.description: <protected header>..<signature>. Header: {alg: ES256 | EdDSA (equal to the key's JWK alg), kid, typ: irlpls-receipt+jws}; no crit, and jwk/jku/x5u are ignored.

tsa_token.description: Optional base64 RFC 3161 token over SHA-256 of the JWS signing input.

iss.description: RFC 6454 ASCII serialisation of the signer's origin (scheme://host[:port], lower-case host, default port omitted, no path or trailing slash), compared as a string. A provider: the origin of its card's provider_url. A shim: the origin of protocol.operator.url.

nonce.description: The buyer's nonce from the order request, echoed. Required.

request_sha256.description: Equal to the Order's request_sha256: the hash of the request the provider priced for this order.

phenomenon_time.description: Equal to the item's phenomenon_time, as delivered.

lat.description: Present exactly when the item carries lat, and equal to it.

lon.description: Present exactly when the item carries lon, and equal to it.

precision_m.description: Present exactly when the item carries precision_m, and equal to it.

protocol_block.description: Proposed additive Capture Card member `protocol`: where and how the provider speaks the irlpls protocol.

endpoint.description: Base URL, no trailing slash. Same registrable domain as the card's provider_url.

mcp.description: Remote MCP server exposing the irlpls_* tools.

jwks_uri.description: JWK Set (jwk_set) for the provider's receipt and webhook keys. Same origin as provider_url. Required when webhooks is true or the provider signs receipts; a shim's keys go in operator.jwks_uri instead.

quote.description: required: every order that could cost anything needs a firm quote_id. An order could cost anything unless its total is known to be "0" before it is placed (a firm offer of "0", or a live reading the card says is free). optional: a direct order with max_total may skip the quote.

operator.description: Set when a shim, not the provider, runs the endpoint.

sandbox.description: True when the endpoint is a sandbox: orders are simulated and never charged or fulfilled. Conformance checkers place test orders only against sandbox endpoints.

field.description: A Request member the answer fills (place, lat, lon, within_minutes, quantity, ...).

ask.description: Untrusted text when it comes from a provider.

code.description: An irlpls problem or reason code (registry in PROTOCOL-DRAFT.md Section 8). policy:<rule> names a Policy field.

jwk.description: A public key in an irlpls JWK Set (RFC 7517). kid, alg and irlpls_use are required. irlpls registers two JWK members: irlpls_use (what the key may sign) and not_after (RFC 3339 date-time after which nothing it signs is accepted; the key is retired, never deleted).

alg.description: ES256 needs kty EC, crv P-256; EdDSA needs kty OKP, crv Ed25519. A receipt's header alg MUST equal it.

irlpls_use.description: receipt: verifies capture receipts only. webhook: verifies webhook signatures only (EdDSA).

not_after.description: RFC 3339 date-time. A receipt whose issued_at is later, or a webhook whose timestamp is later, fails.

jwk_set.description: What jwks_uri (or operator.jwks_uri) serves. kid values are unique within the set.
